description: Real PKCS#7-signed PDF generated by generate_signed_pdf.py using tests/fixtures/certs/phase12_test_signer.pfx (password testpw123). Carries a valid /ByteRange + PKCS#7 /Contents. Cert is self-signed (no trust anchor) so chain validation fails but signature.intact == True. Used by phase-12 AC4/AC5 tests in tests/test_ui_encryption_signatures.py.
